evidence.author: pollinations-ai[bot]
evidence.title: Video models double-charging: Wan, Seedance, and grok-video charging twice per generation
evidence.body:
## Bug Description

Users are being charged **twice** for a single video generation when using certain video models through apps.

## Affected Models
- `Wan`
- `Seedance`
- `grok-video`

## Details
- **Issue occurs when**: Using the models through an app (not via direct browser URL)
- **Expected behavior**: Single charge per video generation
- **Actual behavior**: Double charge per video generation

## Impact
This is a billing bug that affects user balances - users are losing 2x the expected […]

rationale: A successful video request debits the wallet twice.
The named text model returns no result.

evidence.author: Marcus-Mok-GH
evidence.title: [BUG] max_tokens < 16 on Responses-backed models (gpt-6/5.6 family) returns a raw upstream error about 'max_output_tokens', a parameter the caller never sent
evidence.body:
### Summary

Chat Completions requests with a small `max_tokens` (common in tests and cheap probes) fail on every Responses-adapter model with an opaque Azure error that blames `max_output_tokens` — a Responses API parameter the caller never sent. The identical request succeeds on non-Responses models, so the failure looks random per model.

### Repro

```bash
curl -s https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d […]

rationale: A small token limit exposes the wrong API parameter in an error; the report identifies a usable range.
